name: XPRIZE Quantum Applications
organizer: XPRIZE Foundation, Google Quantum AI, and GESDA
description: XPRIZE Quantum Applications is a three-year, USD 5 million global competition challenging teams to develop deployable quantum algorithms for real-world impact in health, climate, energy, and materials science. Launched in March 2024, it attracted 376 registered teams from 82 countries, with seven Phase I finalists sharing USD 1 million in December 2025. A Phase II Wildcard Registration window opened in early 2026, with the grand prize of USD 3 million to be awarded in March 2027.
prizes: USD 5 million total (grand prize USD 3 million)
eligibility: Open to global teams from 82+ countries

news.title: XPRIZE Quantum Applications selects five wildcard finalists for Phase II from 62 submissions
news.excerpt: Five teams selected as Phase II wildcard finalists from 62 submissions, including Pasqal, advancing with applications spanning quantum chemistry, materials science, and scientific simulation.

news.title: Five Wildcard Finalists Announced for XPRIZE Quantum Applications Competition, Including Pasqal
news.excerpt: XPRIZE announced five wildcard finalists from 62 submissions, joining seven Phase I finalists in the $5 million competition. Pasqal (France) was among those selected, advancing to deeper technical validation and real-world benchmarking toward the $3 million grand prize expected in March 2027.
